items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She‘s a good friend and what she does is interesting.

ctx.x: I‘ve also read . . . you‘ve cited Sheila Jordan before, as well. Is she an influence, or someone that you‘d say whose singing you just prefer?

Oh, I just like Sheila a lot. She‘s a good friend and what she does is interesting. I don‘t really, not understand it; I don‘t . . . well, what she does is very interesting. I mean, are you familiar with her work?
